title: 336 Hard Core
style: 174 BPM happy hardcore, 336 Hz drone under the kick, piano stab anthem, euphoric breakdown, vocal hook chop, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — 336 drone, kick drop]
Three thirty-six
Under the floor
Three thirty-six
Hard core core

[Verse 1 — kick + drone]
The frequency under everything we make
The carrier under every move and every break
Three thousand thirty-six in the song
Three thirty-six dot app, eight domains strong
Three-three-six — the operator's sign
Three-three-six — the line under the line

[Build — piano stab climb]
Three
Three
Six
HARD CORE

[Drop — full anthem]
336 HARD CORE!
THE DRONE UNDER THE KICK!
336 HARD CORE!
THE OPERATOR'S TRICK!
336 HARD CORE!
THE FACTORY'S BRICK!

[Verse 2 — kick harder, piano answer]
Eight sites live, real, not forty-eight
Three thirty-six holds every weight
Linear two-zero-two referenced in the queue
Three thirty-six underneath, the carrier true
Hawkeye watching, ZynAsk asking
336 hard core — no more masking

[Breakdown — drone alone]
(low hum, single kick on the four)
Three.
Three.
Six.

[Final Drop — full euphoria]
336 HARD CORE!
THE NUMBER IN THE BLOOD!
336 HARD CORE!
THE CARRIER UNDER THE FLOOD!
336 HARD CORE!
COREY A I — THE GOOD!

[Outro — drone fades]
Three thirty-six.
End of the wave.
Hard core.
End.
